$comment: Review envelope shaped as the request body for POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews. No $schema URI or allOf conditionals: some harness structured-output validators (claude --json-schema) reject them.

body.description: Verdict first, then the criteria satisfied, not applicable, and not judged. A finding that anchors to no diff line goes here. An empty comments array with the inspected surface stated here is a valid clean review.

event.description: REQUEST_CHANGES when a P0-P2 finding survives, carrying at least one comment. COMMENT otherwise — and always for a self-review: GitHub rejects REQUEST_CHANGES and APPROVE from the pull request's own author, so a self-review leads its body with the verdict it would otherwise carry. APPROVE only under an explicit organization grant.

comments.description: One finding per root cause; only findings likely real and actionable.

line.description: Real line number from the diff.

side.description: RIGHT for a new line, LEFT for a deleted one.

body.description: Severity prefix then the defect and what passing looks like. P0 data loss, security, outage; P1 wrong primary-path behavior; P2 other actionable defect; P3 non-blocking.
